newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Mofet to raise $96 mln for venture funds.
newsitem.headline: Mofet to raise $96 mln for venture funds.

text.p: Mofet Israel Technology Fund Ltd said on Thursday it is planning to raise $26 million for its publicly traded venture capital fund and $70 million for a new private venture capital fund.

Rani Cohen, managing director, told Reuters the money for the company's existing fund, traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, would be raised through a rights issue and a public offering. It would increase the fund's total assets to $50 million.

"The timing hasn't been set. The money will be raised sometime this year," said Cohen, adding that the extra capital would help Mofet compete with other big venture capital funds established recently.
He said Mofet has invested in about 24 high tech companies since it was established four years ago.

Another Israeli venture capital fund capital fund, Vertex Venture Capital, is raising $15 million to expand its fund to $35 million, the Haaretz newspaper said. Vertex is an affiliate of Singapore Technologies.
Vertex managers were unavailable for comment.
